reason: Conversation 1 started with a long generic checklist that included an irrelevant gas-dryer warning. It then diagnosed the broken door catch correctly, explained that the interlock is working as designed, and warned against holding the door shut or bypassing the switch. It also asked for the Hotpoint model number needed to identify the right catch or striker, and advised against gluing the piece back. Conversation 2 asked a better first question and gave a sound safety warning. However, it never asked for the make or model, never confirmed that holding the door shut makes the dryer run, and added an unneeded drum-turning check. It also left the homeowner without a clear route to the right replacement part.
